contentText: The UN Security Council meets this afternoon in New York to discuss the situation in the Middle East following reports of a drone strike near the Barakah Nuclear Power Plant in the United Arab Emirates that caused a fire within the facility’s perimeter. IAEA Director General Rafael Mariano Grossi is expected to brief members as concerns grow over nuclear safety and security in the region. Follow our live coverage for updates from the chamber as they happen.
